title: Quick Butter Japanese Fish Pasta
description: A simple and delicious Japanese-inspired pasta dish made with buttery tagliatelle, a sweet glaze, and pan-seared fish. This kid-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the tagliatelle pasta according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the soy sauce, maple syrup, and grated ginger to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the glaze for 2-3 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the cod fillets, skin side up (if they have skin).
Cook the cod for 2-3 minutes on the first side or until golden brown, then flip and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until cooked through.
Add the cooked tagliatelle pasta to the skillet with the glaze and toss to combine.
Add the cooked cod fillets to the pasta and toss to combine, ensuring the fish is coated in the glaze.
Serve the pasta and fish hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
Repeat the process for the second serving of cod if desired.
